title: Wagara
description: One hundred classical Japanese patterns, drawn on canvas from their constructions — waves and hemp stars, tortoiseshell and fretwork, thunder spirals and linked chains, chrysanthemum, cherry and plum, fans, gourds, coins, cranes and rabbits, mist, rain and willow. No image files: every pattern is geometry, and recolors with its tone.
usage: Patterns are drawn, not tiled from images — each has a period and a logic. The picker wraps the stage; captions under the canvas tell each pattern's story.
a11y: Pattern is texture: the canvas is aria-hidden and any text over it must pass contrast on the flat tone color alone, pattern removed. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing changes — patterns were always still.
